objective: Complete the Hermes Commerce Control Plane v0.1.0 implementation and provide a clear deferred runtime verification handoff for Hermes to execute.
summary: Implementation of the unified Hermes Commerce Control Plane CLI and MCP server is complete and fully verified locally (393/393 parallel tests, 393/393 serial tests, 65/65 contract tests are green). Stable Termux wrappers and self-diagnostics are complete. By explicit directive, actual Hermes configuration updates and live runtime probes are deferred to a later Hermes execution run. This handoff provides the exact sequence of commands and checks Hermes must execute to complete runtime verification.
requested_action: Hermes must execute the native installer wrapper, register the commerce-control MCP server, verify that the 11 tools are successfully registered and carry zero secrets, execute the live read-only platform probes, and export the live platform evidence to complete the final verification receipt fields.
limitations: Actual Hermes configuration modifications and live tool invocations via Hermes are deferred.
Mode A rules are strictly enforced; both external-writes and live-value-movement gates are false.
No financial activity, account creation, or wallet secret storage is permitted.
Stage B1 and B2 capabilities are out of scope.
